title: In Psalms 91 What Does It Mean To Dwell In The Secret Place Of The Most High
paragraphs: Understanding Psalm 91: The Secret Place of the Most High

Psalm 91 is beloved by many believers for its promises of protection, deliverance, and assurance of God's presence. The opening verse sets the tone for the entire psalm and introduces the powerful concept of “the secret place of the Most High.” But what does it truly mean to dwell there?
He that dwelleth in the secret place of the Most High Shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. - Psalm 91:1 ASV
1. Defining the “Secret Place”

The “secret place” (Hebrew: seter) refers to a hidden, protected, and intimate space. In the context of Ancient Israel, it evokes the imagery of sanctuary and safety, much like the Holy of Holies in the tabernacle, which symbolized the very presence of God. This place is not a physical location, but a spiritual reality: a relationship of closeness, trust, and ongoing fellowship with God.
Thou shalt hide them in the secret place of thy presence from the plottings of man: Thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues. - Psalm 31:20 ASV
2. “Dwelling” – Not a Visit, But a Lifestyle

The psalmist uses the word “dwelleth,” indicating a continual, habitual living in God's presence. This is not an occasional refuge in times of trouble, but an abiding relationship. Jesus echoed this theme in the New Testament:
Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; so neither can ye, except ye abide in me. - John 15:4 ASV
To “dwell in the secret place” is to live daily in faith, prayer, and trust, relying on God as our ultimate refuge.
3. The Blessings of Dwelling in God’s Presence
Psalm 91 details the blessings for those who dwell in this secret place:
Protection from danger (Psalm 91:3 ASV)
Deliverance from disease (Psalm 91:6 ASV)
Assurance of God’s faithfulness (Psalm 91:4 ASV)
Answered prayer (Psalm 91:15 ASV)
Eternal salvation (Psalm 91:16 ASV)
These blessings are not a guarantee of a trouble-free life, but a promise of God’s presence and care in all circumstances.
4. Christ, the Fulfillment of the Secret Place
From a New Testament perspective, Jesus Christ is the ultimate revelation of the “secret place.” Through faith in Him, believers have access to God’s presence:

Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus, by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh. - Hebrews 10:19 ASV
Salvation by grace through faith in Christ brings the believer into intimate fellowship with God, making the “secret place” a present spiritual reality.
5. How Can We Dwell in the Secret Place?
Faith in Christ: Trusting in Jesus as Savior (Romans 10:9 ASV)
Prayer: Regular, honest communication with God (Philippians 4:6 ASV)
Obedience: Walking according to God’s Word (James 1:22 ASV)
Worship: Adoring God and delighting in His presence (Psalm 27:4 ASV)
Conclusion

To dwell in the secret place of the Most High is to live in continual communion with God, trusting Him as Savior, Refuge, and Friend. It is a daily walk of faith, sustained by His presence and promises, and available to all who come to Him through Jesus Christ.
